facts.fact: The education minister launched PLANETE 3 on 3 October 2025; its teacher module lets teachers enter absences and produce report cards, while students and parents follow marks and absences and school heads supervise.
The system coordinator said PLANETE 3 now covers all cycles from preschool to secondary, preschool and elementary having long been left out of computerisation.

The ministry officially launched the new version PLANETE 3 on 3 October 2025, with a mobile app for pupils and parents, online school-fee payment and dashboards at school, inspectorate, central and ministry level.
PLANETE 3 is run by the ministry's informatisation system unit, whose coordinator presented it at the launch chaired by the minister.
The minister placed PLANETE 3 within the Stratégie du Numérique pour l'Éducation 2025-2029.
